thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High latency and 504s observed on /v1/generate in us-east-1 (severity: P1). Trigger: 5xx rate > 8% for 10m. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/latency|latency-runbook> PagerDuty: PD-4521
Josh: I'm taking the page — jumping into pool metrics and kvcache stats.
Ravi: I'll start tailing inference logs and check pod memory + GC.
Kate: Customer impact: initial signal shows elevated latency for ~30m, affecting 32 tenants; 2 dedicated customers reporting errors. Flagging for comms after quick mitigation.
Josh: Observed KV cache growth on serve-pool-3, evictions not keeping up. Throttling of requests + backlog causing queuing. Trying a graceful restart of pool-3 nodes to clear cache.
Ana: Noted a burst of long-context requests from a single client (tenant-42) that correlated with memory pressure.
Josh: Rolling restart executed: `kubectl rollout restart sts/serve-pool-3 -n inference` — restarted sequentially, 3 nodes at 13:42 UTC. Traffic routed to fallback capacity during restarts.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial service restoration. Monitoring for 30m.
Ravi: Post-restart, 5xxs dropped to baseline, median latency back to SLO. Confirming KV cache eviction metrics now normal.
Maya: Support noted two customers filed errors; CS on standby to send initial note once we confirm root cause.
Kate: Good. Handoff to post-incident: need postmortem + action items. I'll schedule a 60m postmortem with SRE, Runtime, Product, and CS. Proposed time: tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
Ana: I can take the runtime action item for cache resilience. Need sizing: kernel-level change vs config tweak? Initial guess: 3 dev days + 2 QA days.
Ravi: I'll own the investigation for why evictions fell behind (possibly regression in eviction scheduler). Estimate: 2 dev days + 1 day of testing.
Josh: I'll document the mitigation steps and add playbook notes. Estimate: 4 hours.
Sarah: I'll draft customer comms + post-incident summary template. Estimate: 2 hours.
Kate: Prioritization: severity P1 -> action items go into the reliability backlog this sprint and mark as medium-urgent for Q2 OKR alignment (Reliability: reduce cache-induced P1s).
Ana: For the runtime work, can we scope a short-term config change to lower risk while longer fix ships? If yes, add an action: "temporary eviction threshold tweak" (est: 1 dev day).
Josh: Agree. Add that as quick mitigation owner: Josh (oncall) 1 day.
Ravi: Also request: add an automated test that simulates long-context burst to catch regressions (est: 3 days to write harness + run matrix).
Kate: Summary of action items (we'll put these in Jira during the PM meeting):
- A1 Investigate eviction regression (owner: Ravi) — est 3d (2 dev + 1 test) — priority: P1 -> sprint+Q2 reliability OKR
- A2 Runtime: eviction resilience + backpressure (owner: Ana) — est 5d (3 dev + 2 QA) — priority: P1
- A3 Quick config mitigation: eviction threshold tweak (owner: Josh) — est 1d — priority: immediate
- A4 Post-incident doc + mitigation playbook updates (owner: Josh) — est 4h
- A5 Customer comms and CS template (owner: Sarah) — est 2h
- A6 Add regression test harness for long-context bursts (owner: Ravi) — est 3d
Kate: Can everyone ack owners and estimates so I can create epics and map to quarters? Please reply with :thumbsup: or adjustments.
Ana: :thumbsup: (Ana) — I can try to compress QA by pairing with Ravi where it overlaps.
Ravi: :thumbsup: — adjust A1 to 2.5d if we parallelize tests.
Josh: :thumbsup: will file the quick mitigation PR today and post link.
Sarah: :thumbsup: I'll prep the CS note draft and share before the PM.
Maya: I'll queue support follow-ups and track impacted tenant list for CS.
Kate: Scheduling: postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC, calendar invite sent to participants + infra leads. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items + owners + deadlines, customer comms.
Josh: After PM, let's ensure items have clear acceptance criteria and QA steps. Example acceptance for A2: eviction should not exceed 60% of cache capacity for sustained 15m under burst workload and no increase in 5xxs.
Ana: I'll draft acceptance criteria and link to test harness.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident postmortem in /incidents/ with severity tag and link action items to Jira tickets.
Kate: Thanks team — nice mitigation work. We'll reconvene in the PM and turn these estimates into sprint tasks.
Josh: closing page.
